role: Developer reference describing the overnight HRV recording pipeline (data model, pause/resume, morning processing, scoring, charts, migrations, UI data flow, mutation contract, sleep editor, notifications, HealthKit export), the Fitness workout pipeline, route awareness, training-load math and the AI dispatch path.
toplevel: Markdown only; no executable content. Code blocks are pseudo-code flow descriptions.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference
units.does: no behavioural claim: document title.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for the data model subsections.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > RRPoint
units.does: Claims RRPoint holds t_ms (cumulative sum of prior RR, not wall time), rr_ms, optional wallClockMs (streaming only, gap-aware), optional hr (streaming only), and computed endMs = t_ms + rr_ms; beats dropped on BLE disconnect leave no gap in t_ms while wallClockMs advances. Matches RRModels.swift:4-54 and PolarManager appendStreamedBeat.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > RRSeries
units.does: Claims RRSeries = points + sessionId + startDate, and that startDate + t_ms/1000 gives cumulative time while startDate + wallClockMs/1000 gives gap-aware time. Matches RRModels.swift:71-74.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > HRVSession
units.does: Lists HRVSession fields: id/startDate/endDate/state (.collecting/.analyzing/.complete/.paused/.failed), sessionType (.overnight/.nap/.quick/.breathe/.workout), rrSeries, analysisResult, sleepStartMs/sleepEndMs, sleepSegments, linkedSessionIds, pausedDate, dataSourceSummary, sleepSnapshot and vitalsSnapshot frozen at acceptance, recoveryScore on 0-10 scale. Enum cases and fields match SessionMetadata.swift:68-73, :145-198, :384-390.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > SessionArchiveEntry (in-memory index)
units.does: Claims SessionArchiveEntry index fields (sessionId, date, endDate, fileHash, filePath, recoveryScore, meanRMSSD, meanHR/stressIndex backfilled by migrateMetrics, meanSDNN, tags, notes, sessionType, linkedSessionIds) and that retrieveLightweight skips rrSeries for dashboard/history/paused search. Fields match SessionMetadata.swift:710-732 (doc omits later sleepEnd/sleepSegmentCount/stage-minute fields); migrateMetrics backfills meanHR/stressIndex.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 2. Recording Phase
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for recording phase.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 2. Recording Phase > Start: `startOvernightStreaming()`
units.does: Claims tapping Record first refuses (alreadyRecording) while a night is still being ended (ending claim younger than 30 min; older claims dropped with a warning), then creates an overnight HRVSession dated now, starts BLE streaming via PolarManager, resets the cumulative counter and runs a 1 s timer for the elapsed clock and incremental backup. Code: startOvernightStreaming calls refuseWhileEndingInProgress (StreamingLifecycle.clearEndingForNewNight), takes sessionType (.overnight or .nap), starts streaming, launches the H10 loop when applicable, starts HealthKit observers, persists recording state and starts a 1 Hz timer.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 2. Recording Phase > Streaming data arrives: PolarManager (`PolarManager+Streaming.swift`, the stream
units.does: Claims each streamed RR sample becomes RRPoint(t_ms: running cumulative, rr_ms, wallClockMs: ms since stream start, hr) appended to _streamedRRPoints and the cumulative counter advances by rr. Code matches (appendStreamedBeat); additionally zero intervals are skipped, a safety cap stops appends, Verity Sense PPI goes through StrapPPIFilter, and all beats in one BLE batch share the batch-arrival wallClockMs. Ingestion is via StrapHRSample from the strap HR service, not a per-sample Polar SDK callback.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for pause/resume.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow > Pause: `pauseOvernightStreaming()`
units.does: Claims Pause runs gatherOvernightData → mergeParentSessionData → processOvernightData, marks the session .paused with pausedDate, archives it with a re-upload request and, only when that write succeeded, swaps the recording marker for the paused id in UserDefaults; when the write fails the downloaded strap beats are backed up under a fresh id (rescueDownloadedBeats) and the pause is shown unsaved. Code: CollectorSessionControl.pauseWithFullAnalysis.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow > Resume: `resumeOvernightStreaming(linkedSessionId:)`
units.does: Claims Resume refuses while a night is being ended, creates a new HRVSession linked to the parent, updates the parent's archived copy in place (archive.update with a re-upload request) to append the child id, restarts streaming with the counter reset to 0, clears collectedPoints and sets pausedBeatCount to the parent's count. Code matches (RRCollector+PauseResume.swift resumeOvernightStreaming / linkChildToParent); it also inherits the parent's sessionType and links the child only after streaming starts.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow > Finalize: `finalizeFromPause()`
units.does: Claims Done-without-resume marks the archive's copy complete in place (archive.update(requestingReupload: true) { state = .complete }), so a rewrite made since the pause is kept, publishes that copy and sets needsAcceptance = true. Code: CollectorSessionControl.finalizeFromPause / rearchiveFinalized in RRCollector+PauseResume.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for stop/morning processing.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing > Stop: `stopOvernightStreaming()`
units.does: Claims Stop tears down streaming, backs up beats, then with >=120 streamed beats (any beats for a resumed child) downloads the strap recording concurrently with HealthKit sleep (no strap fetch for Verity Sense), picks a source and runs mergeParentSessionData → processOvernightData; otherwise falls back to a strap-primary fetch that fails the session when barred or < 120 beats; the download is barred (nightFetchAllowed) by Skip, a streaming-only capture mode, a Verity Sense, or a night that never armed the strap while the strap reports no recording, the gate then clearing the arming flag (closeNightGate). Code matches (RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing > gatherOvernightData() (pause path, `RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift`)
units.does: Claims gatherOvernightData (in RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift, the pause path) stops the stream as the morning stop does (stopStreamingInfrastructure), backs up the streamed beats, downloads the strap recording when the strap gate allows (fetchNightFromStrap), picks streaming/internal/composite, backs up the downloaded beats under their own id and fails the session when the night is too short or nothing is usable, and returns OvernightDataResult including downloadedPoints.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing > mergeParentSessionData()
units.does: Claims that when the session has a parent id and the parent has RR data in the archive, child t_ms and wallClockMs are shifted by (child.startDate − parent.startDate) ms, merged = parent.points + shifted child, and the merged base session takes the parent's startDate. Code matches; additionally a non-positive or unrepresentable offset refuses the merge and returns the child alone.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 5. processOvernightData() — The Main Pipeline
units.does: Claims the morning pipeline: backup, build series, same-night merge only for overnights with sessionMergeMode != .off, skipping already-linked sessions and keeping only segments within the merge gap (segmentsWithinGap), artifact detection, verification, HealthKit sleep (cache-first via SleepDataCache, a UserDefaults store sealed with JSONFileSeal.app, 14 entries, ±1 day, else bounded poll 15×2 s), sleep-stage classification, training load, window selection with Tier-1 ranking and wall-clock→t_ms translation, organized zones, HRV analysis, final session, recovery score, supersede same-night, archive. Code: RRCollector wrapper fetches training load first, then MorningProcessingService.run does backup → buildMergedSeries → artifacts/verify → sleep poll → window → analysis → vitals snapshot → insufficient-data gate → score → supersede; the wrapper archives via archiveForReview; SleepDataCache.swift seals its store.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 6. Recovery Score Calculation (scoring version v3.3.nov2026)
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header naming scoring version v3.3.nov2026 (matches ScoringVersion.current).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 6. Recovery Score Calculation (scoring version v3.3.nov2026) > RecoveryScoreCalculator (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift)
units.does: Claims the score is HRV+Sleep+Vitals with training load excluded; Tier 1 SWC band (z=-3→5, -1.5→25, -0.75→64, -0.5…+0.5→72, +1.5→90) plus DFA/RHR/CV/ANS adjustments and staleness penalty; Tier 2 sleep sub-weights 35/25/25/15, HRV 70/Sleep 30, dampened to 85/15 when z<-1 and sleep<50; Tier 3 60/25/15 with vitals mean of RHR (-10/SD), RR (-15/br/min beyond ±1, population 12-18 fallback, below 12 → 90), temp (≤0.3→100, ≤0.5→75, ≤1.0→50, >1.0→25, positive only); Respiratory/WristTemperature baseline caches with 30-day TTL; Comeback 80/20/0; SpO2 <95 % → −10. All numbers match ScoringWeights, scoringParametersV2 and ScoreDetailBuilder.buildTier2.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 6. Recovery Score Calculation (scoring version v3.3.nov2026) > Training Load (Load & Trajectory surface — does NOT feed the recovery score)
units.does: Claims training load (Banister TRIMP, ATL 7 d / CTL 42 d / TSB, ACWR labels, Foster monotony banner when monotony > 2.0 AND strain > 200) is shown on Load & Trajectory / Training Detail and frozen into analysisResult.trainingContext, not the score.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 7. Chart Display
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for chart display.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 7. Chart Display > OvernightChartsView
units.does: Claims computeOvernightStats resolves sleep boundaries moved onto the t_ms axis (onBeatClock), computes sleep-window HR (per segment on split nights, falling back to the full set) and full HR values, rolling RMSSD over a 300-beat window centred on every 30th beat, peak HRV in the 30-70 % band of the resolved sleep window (peakSearchBand; all samples when none falls in it), and sleep duration; Canvas X axis is t_ms relative to firstMs/lastMs endMs; line breaks when consecutive points are > 300 000 ms apart; five x labels at the wall-clock time of their t_ms positions (clockTimeLabels/axisTime); window overlay by ms; organized zones from analysisResult or computeOrganizedZonesOnDemand (cached by session and sleep window), written to the archive in the background when the scan ran and the stored copy has none (backfillZonesToArchive, no re-upload).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 7. Chart Display > Key chart rendering detail:
units.does: Worked example: with correctly offset child t_ms the chart shows segment 1, a > 5 min gap with no line, then segment 2; without the offset both segments overlap in x. Consistent with the 300 000 ms segment split and childPointsOffsetToParent.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary)
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header stating there are two merge paths.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary) > Path A: Pause/Resume (mergeParentSessionData)
units.does: Claims Path A (pause/resume) merges parent + offset child via mergeParentSessionData in stop/pause before processOvernightData. Matches pauseWithFullAnalysis and analyzeAndFinalizeOvernight.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary) > Path B: Same-Night Separate Sessions (processOvernightData)
units.does: Claims Path B merges independent same-night overnight sessions inside processOvernightData, sorted and offset from the earliest start, skipping sessions in linkedSessionIds. Code also skips ids linked from any same-night entry and limits to the merge gap / mode.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary) > The interaction:
units.does: Claims for a pause/resumed session Path A runs first, Path B then skips the parent (linked) and may still find other independent same-night sessions. Matches sameNightSegments' alreadyLinked filter.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 9. Full Session Lifecycle
units.does: Lifecycle walkthrough of continuous (stop via stopOvernightStreaming), pause/resume (pause via gatherOvernightData, a later stop via stopOvernightStreaming), independent same-night and crash-recovery cases. Option D: findRecoverableArchivedSession searches overnight entries < 24 h old with meanRMSSD nil or recoveryScore ≤ 1.0 and returns the candidate only when exactly one matches; with several it logs the ambiguity (logAmbiguousRecoveryCandidates) and returns nil, and the strap file is filed by its own start; with one, the download reuses that session's id and rewrites the placeholder.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 10. HR-Estimated Sleep (fallback)
units.does: Claims HR-estimated sleep runs only when HealthKit returns 0 minutes: RR-based estimateSleepFromHR first, then HealthKit HR over the window extended to the schedule end with 20-min smoothing, ≥ 8 bpm range, threshold max − 0.5·range, onset on 2 consecutive points (kept within 20 min after bedtime, else bedtime), wake at end of last below-threshold block, ≥ 12 samples and ≥ 120 min; live sessions keep loading when nothing found; AutoSleepExtension is never constructed in production. Matches MorningResultsViewModel and HRSleepEstimator.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 11. App Startup & Deferred Migrations
units.does: Claims startup: RRCollector.init loads the index, rebuilds baseline if daysCollected == 0, sets up bindings/observers, restores paused state off-main, runs repairMergeDataLoss gated by a flag; the housekeeping phase runs archive.runDeferredMigrations (reencryptPendingSessions, resealPlainIndexIfNeeded, recoveryScores, endDates, metrics, sleepIndexFields, legacyEliteImportIndex, removeDuplicates — tie keeper by session id, loser's tags/notes/morning feeling/perceived readiness carried into the re-uploaded keeper — relinkSameNightSessions) and expires 90-day Trash; SessionDataMigrations.runAllIfNeeded (InsufficientData, TrainingRecalibration, TrimpRepair, WorkoutSleepCleanup, NapRepair, TimeInBedRepair) with their UserDefaults flags, NapRepair/TimeInBedRepair/WorkoutSleepCleanup writing with archive.update and leaving their flag unset when any write failed; parity test files named. Code: Archive+Migrations.swift, SessionDataMigrations+*.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 11a. UI Session Data Flow
units.does: Claims MainTabView owns the dashboard slice (seeded count, 50 ms reload guard), TrendsV2View/HistoryView load independently, every view observes RRCollector.archiveVersion and CloudKitSyncManager.pullVersion, dashboard loads recentSessionsAsync(limit: 35), Trends loads limit nil then filters overnight/analysisResult/isReliableForHRVAggregates in TimeRange 7/14/30/90/all, History uses archive.entries; each view's refresh cancels its prior one except TrendsV2View.loadSessions, which runs one load at a time and repeats it when a refresh came during it (reloadRequested); mutation paths call notifyArchiveChanged. Dashboard numbers: dashboardSessionLoadLimit 35, 0.05 s guard.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 12. Key Files Reference
units.does: Key-files table mapping pipeline responsibilities to files: streamed RRPoint creation in PolarManager+Streaming.swift (appendStreamedBeat), RR models, the HRVSession model in SessionMetadata.swift (HRVSession.swift holds its decoding support), overnight start/stop and mergeParentSessionData in RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift, gatherOvernightData in RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift, pause/resume, morning processing, device recording, the recovery score (v3.3.nov2026), sleep staging and merging, boundary resolution, overnight charts, the sleep editor and its model, the narrative generator, the insufficient-data migration and morning feeling tags. All listed files exist.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract
units.does: Claims an archived session is frozen except for explicit user actions, the one-shot launch migrations, the automatic sleep refresh of today's session, and additive fill-in merges of late HealthKit data.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract > 13.1 User-initiated mutations (full-overwrite allowed)
units.does: Lists full-overwrite mutation paths: reanalyzeSession, retroApplySleepSettings, applyManualAnalysis, updateSessionSleepBoundaries (timeline Done), repairTrainingSnapshots (Troubleshooting → Advanced Diagnostics, and once at launch via runTrimpRepairMigrationIfNeeded), the launch one-shot migrations (SessionDataMigrations.runAllIfNeeded: InsufficientData rescore, TrainingRecalibration and TrimpRepair rewrite training snapshot and frozen readiness only, WorkoutSleepCleanup strips workout sleep snapshots, NapRepair and TimeInBed recompute scores), SessionRecoveryService fallback, CloudKit merge, session resume.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract > 13.2 Automatic additive-merge paths (fill-in-only)
units.does: Claims automatic paths: RecoveryScoreDetailView vitals refresh (on open and on each MorningCoordination.vitalsDataVersion bump while open) fills nil vitalsSnapshot fields via RecoveryVitalsBackfill with strap RHR winning, the only path that writes late vitals (no dashboard refresh; VitalsDetailV2View re-fetches for display only); any non-nil frozen sleepSnapshot is used unchanged at scoring (MorningProcessingService.scoringHealthData), HK fetched only when absent, nothing heals an empty snapshot except autoRefreshTodaysSleepIfImproved for today's session; autoRefreshTodaysSleepIfImproved (skips when sleepUserAdjusted, rewrites sleepSnapshot on improvement, posts .flowRecoveryRescoreNeeded on ≥ 20 min delta or first snapshot); installRescoreListener reanalyzes and records PendingScoreChange.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract > 13.3 Integrity contract
units.does: Claims past sessions reopen with identical recoveryScore/scoreBreakdown/frozenReadiness/trainingSnapshot (launch migrations aside); today's session is rescored on every HK sleep bump that passes SleepRefreshPolicy.sleepRefreshVerdict (≥ 20 min, onset move, source upgrade to Watch, first snapshot) with no once-only guard; the banner is written only for a displayed change of 3 or more (recordPendingScoreChangeIfMeaningful), smaller changes apply silently; loading never rescores; cites SessionImmutabilityTests.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 14. Sleep Timeline Editor
units.does: Claims SleepDetailV2View presents SleepTimelineEditorView: canvas bars, 5-min snapped drags with 44 pt targets, split/carve/merge/delete, long-press add, 5-entry undo; Done builds SleepData via SleepScienceAnalyzer.buildSleepDataFromTimelineState (re-splits by awake, unspecified intervals count to total only) then ReanalysisService.updateSessionSleepBoundaries(isUserAdjustment: true) sets sleepUserAdjusted, rescores, archives and fires onArchiveChanged; provenance enum .watch/.iphone/.hrvDerived/.userAdded/.userCarved. Code matches (undo limit 5, 5*60 s step, 44 pt); the provenance enum also has .userAdjusted, which the doc omits.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 15. Morning Feeling & Divergence Narrative
units.does: Claims the dashboard morning-feeling prompt (5 emoji; 3-5 commit after a 1 s cancellable delay, 1-2 show tags and wait for Done: Body Infection/Allergies/Hangover/Stomach/Sore/Tired/Headache, Mind Stressed/Down) writes via viewModel.updateMorningFeeling onto the HRVSession, and AnalysisSummaryGenerator.feelBadAdvice gives per-tag advice that appendFeelingSteps inserts at the top of the action steps (feeling ≤ 2; feeling ≥ 4 with a score under 65 gets the feel-good-HRV-low line).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 16. Archive Status Visibility
units.does: Claims an interrupted recording surfaces as the launch 'Session Interrupted' alert, checked after the archive's launch boot (LaunchArchiveBoot), raised only with no launch modal on screen and re-run when the score-architecture cover closes (handleLaunchModalChange), with Save/Resume claiming the session from launch auto-recovery (InterruptedWorkoutAutoRecovery.claim) after waiting up to 150 s in all while auto-recovery holds it (claimRecovery: 'Saved to your archive.' once saved, a still-being-recovered message at the deadline); Resume / Save as Complete / Dismiss, or Save to Archive / Dismiss; Dismiss keeps the backup for Recover Lost Sessions; no dashboard banner; the dashboard shows ScoreChangedBanner (≥ 3 points, recordPendingScoreChangeIfMeaningful); Settings → iCloud & Data storage summary and Force iCloud Sync; Repair Training History behind Advanced Diagnostics, also run once at launch via runTrimpRepairMigrationIfNeeded. Code: EmuquApp.swift, AppLaunchRecovery.swift, SessionReanalysisCoordinator+Listeners.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 16. Archive Status Visibility > Morning notification scheduling
units.does: Claims a repeating UNCalendarNotificationTrigger at dailyReportFixedTime plus, in Smart delivery, an immediate push from the sleep observer when the freshest sleep end is within 90 min and today's push is not settled (UserDefaults date and settled flags; a number-free push sent before the night was scored is replaced once when the score exists). Code matches and additionally requires the wake to fall within 7 h before the schedule's morning cutoff (isMorningWake) and notification authorization.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 16. Archive Status Visibility > Known Deferred
units.does: Lists deferred features: a 14-day re-engagement push (lastOvernightSessionDate not implemented — grep finds no such field) and A/B push format beyond 'Auto = teaser for the first 30 nights, then the full readout while notification previews are hidden on the locked screen'.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 17. HealthKit Export (Write-Back)
units.does: Claims exportSessionMetrics writes windowed SDNN or one summary, per-minute HR samples, one nocturnal-median RHR per day, and sleep only when HR-estimated, each gated and isolated; every write replaces through HealthSampleReplacer (read earlier, save new, delete those read that the save did not replace by sync id — notReplacedBySync; same-session replacements one at a time; bounded by the timeout, writeTimeout 30 s for HR/HRV/sleep saves and deletes); every sample and workout carries ExternalUUID and SyncIdentifier with a rising SyncVersion (HealthExportIdentity.metadata); HealthKitWorkoutExport finds earlier workouts by identity or same-second start, saves the new one with net active energy, deletes the earlier ones per type, workouts last, throwing on failure; with the earlier exports unreadable on a locked phone (findUnlessLocked) it saves, notes the session in PendingWorkoutReplacements and deletes nothing, and the next backfillWorkoutsToHealthKit first deletes all but the newest (finish); the export stamp is written without a re-upload request; a trimmed/rebuilt workout drops its export stamp so the backfill re-exports it; delete forever runs HealthWriteAndObserve.removeExports over HRV, HR, RHR, sleep and workouts.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18. Fitness Tab — Workout Recording Pipeline
units.does: Claims the live-workout pipeline: start() reconnects known secondary sensors, starts strap streaming, GPS/altimeter (lazy WorkoutLocationManager), pedometer, foot pod/PM5/FTMS, Watch session, α1 analyzer, voice coach, Zwift broadcast (only with enableZwiftBroadcast and this device's disclosure acceptance, BroadcasterDisclosure) and a 1 Hz ticker; each tick ingests RR into LiveDFAAnalyzer, backs up, records samples, auto-detects a saved route after 500 m, updates threshold counters, refreshes weather and road geocoding, publishes a LiveWorkoutSnapshot, pushes Watch/Zwift state (Zwift only while advertising), runs voice-coach engines whose fired events play a phone and Watch haptic for .haptic or urgent events and speak .spoken and urgent .haptic ones (routine lines not spoken during an AI voice turn), turn/mile-marker engines and the interval controller; stop() closes an open pause at the stop time, snapshots RR without stopping the stream, tears down live services, finalizes via WorkoutAnalyzer (which also stores each GPS fix time, gpsFixTimes), archives a breadcrumb trail, disconnects the foot pod, flips to .finished and runs detached HRR capture before stopping the strap. Services reached through AppDependencies.current.location.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18. Fitness Tab — Workout Recording Pipeline > Post-summary cards data flow
units.does: Claims FitnessPostSummaryView cards read workoutMetadata: headline stats, route map, HRR card, charts, α1 timeline (0.75/0.50), route by α1 band, an α1 LT1 estimate shown only (deliberately no LTHR update suggestion, as ThresholdCards+Cards.swift states), threshold crossings, zone distribution, derived metrics, physiology, splits, GPX/CSV/TCX export.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18a. Route Awareness Pipeline (where road names and turn cues come from)
units.does: Claims RoadAwarenessEngine.snap uses a course only when bearingTrust passes (course reported, speed ≥ 0.7 m/s, course accuracy no worse than 30°), fetches a RoadGraphService tile (250 m cells, 800 m radius, 6 h TTL or 10 min for an empty tile, coalesced, 1.1 s gap, 8 s timeout), snaps with confidence 0.7·distance + 0.3·bearing agreement, walks ahead 600 m / 3 intersections, never invents a name; RoadGeocodingService uses MKLocalSearch then CLGeocoder (5 s, 30 s recovery after 8 failures), cross-street search over radii 200/500/1500/3000 m, 15 m / 60 s gates since the last success, no lookup while one runs.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18b. Fitness — Retroactive Repair Actions
units.does: Claims two summary-sheet repairs: real-elevation lookup via TopoElevationService (≤ 100 samples, NED 10 m in US else SRTM 30 m, the SRTM retry 1 s after a US lookup, requests through the HTTPTransport passed in, 15 m sustained-climb threshold, preview then write + notifyArchiveChanged) and α1 re-analysis (2-min windows at 20 s, Kubios-style ±20 % vs 5-beat median with interpolation, nearest-in-time replacement, early samples cleared). Constants match TopoElevationService, WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer and LiveDFAAnalyzer.cleanRRForDFA (which also rejects RR < 300 or > 2000 ms).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18c. Elevation capture — pro-grade barometric pipeline
units.does: Claims barometric samples are buffered unthresholded during recording and at finalize BarometricAltitudeProcessor applies a symmetric moving average over a 15 s window read from the timestamps and 2 m hysteresis to compute gain/loss, falling back to GPS gain when no barometer; retroactive repair via TopoElevationService (NED 10 m in the US, else or after a failed NED call SRTM 30 m, through its HTTPTransport).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 19. Training Load Math (Research Citations)
units.does: Claims Banister TRIMP per beat with sex coefficients (ranges 0-4.37 / 0-4.57 per min), Edwards fallback when HRrest unknown, hrTSS = session TRIMP / 1 h at LTHR TRIMP × 100 returning nil if HRmax, HRrest or LTHR missing, LTHR = override else 0.88 × max HR, and the post-summary shows the α1 LT1 estimate without offering it as an LTHR override (ThresholdCards.alpha1LT1EstimateCard).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow
units.does: no behavioural claim: section intro pointing to docs/VOICE_AND_TOOL_USE.md for rationale.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Entry point
units.does: Claims send trims the text and returns early for empty text, Flo off or notice not accepted, a medical-guard answer, or an active provider that can't take a turn (ProviderRegistry.canSend: no key, Apple unavailable, switched off); then, for a voice turn with no stream in flight, servedDeterministically tries DeterministicIntent.tryMatch (14-pattern catalog) and on a hit appends the exchange on the device before the consent check; otherwise holds the text for consent, queues behind a stream or dispatches. Lists the 14 pattern ids. Code: AssistantViewModel.send.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Provider resolution
units.does: Claims routing: non-Apple selection or Manual → user's pick; voice with Apple selected → first available consented cloud (default model) else Apple; Quick/Deep pin the tier, Auto counts the turn then uses SmartProviderRouter (storing the session tier); Deep with a cloud mapping is capped at 50/day then downgraded to .auto; TierProviderMapper quick → Apple, auto → consented Grok then DeepSeek else Apple, deep → same mid-tier cloud; action-intent override moves tool-needing turns off Apple to the first consented cloud; a provider ProviderRegistry.canSend refuses gets the unavailable error and a new message's user turn is taken back (AssistantTurnRouter.dispatch).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Capability classification (Auto mode)
units.does: Claims CapabilityClassifier: keyword heuristic per axis (every gate open for confidently non-English text), gated AND with NLContextualEmbedding cosine ≥ 0.55 per axis when available, else keyword-only for English and no flags otherwise; 0/1/≥2 flags → quick/auto/deep; stickiness: upgrades always, turns 1-3 follow the proposal (turnCount <= 3), quick with no flags escapes, else keep current tier.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Apple Foundation send (Quick tier)
units.does: Claims the Apple path sets AppleToolDispatcher's registry, strips the cache marker, compacts history to 0.70 × 4096 minus system tokens keeping the latest user turn, wraps tools via AppleToolCatalog, reuses a cached LanguageModelSession unless instructions/tool hash change, ≥ 20 turns, a fresh conversation, token overflow, or the exchange before the new question is not the one the session last answered word for word (AppleExchange), streams with maximumResponseTokens 512 yielding text deltas. Constants match AppleContextCompactor and SessionCache.maxTurnsPerSession = 20; AppleExchange.before in AppleFoundationProvider.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Tool-call resolution path (Apple)
units.does: Claims Apple tool calls go AppleToolAdapter.call → AppleToolDispatcher.dispatch, which returns an explicit no-registry error JSON when unset, charges the call text to the allowance, refuses web_search and calls past the per-turn budget, else CompactToolRouter.resolveTool (read results through the registry's gate: rate limit, 80 KB cap; actions only in allowedActionNames) and toToolResultJSON.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Cloud provider send (Auto / Deep tier)
units.does: Claims cloud sends build provider-specific bodies (Anthropic cache_control 1 h on tools/system/last turn with a <live_state> block appended to the last user message; OpenAI-compatible function calling; Gemini function_declarations), loop up to 8 tool calls per turn (AssistantViewModel.maxToolCallsPerTurn), turn a fallbackable failure after a mutating tool ran into PickedModelFailure that no fallback takes (runRoundKeepingActionsOnThisModel, mutatingToolNames), and record .usage into LLMCacheTelemetry.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Telemetry sinks
units.does: Claims usage events feed LLMCacheTelemetry, one record per provider request (cumulative hit ratio cachedRead/(input+cachedRead+cacheCreate); the newest 50 records give a last-10 rolling ratio and a per-provider summary) shown in Settings → Troubleshooting AI cache health card; SmartProviderRouter.route keeps no telemetry and only logs each decision; nothing is persisted or sent off-device.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Voice preamble (model identity earcon)
units.does: Claims the first voice reply of a session is prefixed 'Flo here. <Model>.' (or 'Flo here.' with no provider), workout coach uses 'Coach here.'. Matches announced(); scripted/trigger speech skips the preamble.
